description: Phase-distortion waveshaper that adds brightness and saturation; it colours the signal even with the Amount knob fully counter-clockwise

params.text: Sets the depth of the distortion, from 0 fully counter-clockwise to 5 fully clockwise
Attenuverts the CV that shifts the distortion depth, -1 to +1
Sets the voltage range expected at the input, 5V or 10V; the input is clipped to that range and the output scaled back out to it

inputs.text: Shifts the distortion depth, through its own attenuverter

outputs.text: The distorted signal, within the selected voltage range
